name: Medical Measurements
old_description: Your trusted source for Medical Equipment purchases. Including Autoclaves, Patient Monitoring, EKGs and Stress Test, Power Exam Tables, Microscopes, Ultrasonic Cleaners
about:
Medical Measurements operates from Lafayette, Louisiana, supplying medical and veterinary equipment to healthcare providers. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm distributes a range of clinical devices including autoclaves, patient monitoring systems, EKG and stress-test machines, power exam tables, microscopes, and ultrasonic cleaners. It also stocks autoclave consumables such as gaskets, cleaner, trays, and parts, along with ECG/EKG electrodes and chart paper, and provides repair services both on-site and via mail-in for equipment including Welch Allyn monitors and Bionet devices.

Customers span human medical practices and veterinary clinics. The company highlights its focus on the veterinary community with dedicated equipment sales and service, and carries brands such as Tuttnauer, Bionet, and Welch Allyn.

Medical Measurements emphasizes its combined sales and repair model, offering on-site and mail-in service alongside equipment supply.
